meta.doc: rightone-platform/docs/RightOne-Design-Brief-EN/02-Design-Tokens.md (R1-UXD-003 v1.0), retuned 29 September 2026 to the Tailwind CSS v4 default theme: its colour palette, 4 px spacing unit, type, radius, shadow, breakpoint and z-index scales. Semantic names are R1's; each maps to one Tailwind utility (README, Tailwind mapping). Dark theme added and made the default on 1 October 2026: every semantic name has a dark value on the Tailwind gray scale, height reads as lighter surfaces, status tints are the family colour at 12 %. Materials and state layers added the same day: glass for bars and opened layers with a legibility filter, see-through hover and pressed fills, see-through dividers on the dark theme, stone-tinted light shadows, and component tokens for Artwork so no component reads a primitive. Brand colours applied on 1 October 2026 from the RightOne logo (Option 1, "Three Rights to One"): Midnight Navy #102A43 and Digital Teal #00A8D9 replace Tailwind gray and stone (neutrals) and blue (the accent); the logo's blues #027EC3 and #044E88 carry info and the second chart series; the track tones become teal and blue. Green, amber and red stay Tailwind for status. This closes the colour part of OD-04 for design; the logo mark itself waits for its vector file.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Application background. Dark, the default: navy-950, the darkest step of the logo's navy; cards sit on it in Midnight Navy (navy-900, 1.20:1 against the page) with a navy-800 hairline. Light (paper and print): navy-50, a cool tint under white cards (1.11:1). Player: navy-975, a near-black navy for a dark room.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row under the pointer, the focused row and an expanded detail row. Dark: navy-850, so a link in a hovered row keeps 4.64:1 (accent) and muted text 5.95:1. Light: navy-50. Player: navy-975.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: A state layer laid over whatever is under a quiet button, chip, segment, list or menu entry while the pointer is on it. Dark: white at 10 % (on a navy-900 card it reads as #283f56). Light: Midnight Navy at 8 %. Because it is see-through, one token serves every ground. A quiet button's words turn accent-strong under it (5.46:1). Player: navy-900.

tokens.name: control-pressed
tokens.usage: The same state layer while pressed: white at 16 % on the dark theme, Midnight Navy at 14 % on the light theme. Player: navy-800.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel, table, dialog. Dark: Midnight Navy (navy-900, #102A43), the logo's own colour. Light: white. Player: navy-950.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A layer that opens over other content: menus, list boxes, the calendar, toggletips, toasts, dialogs, side panels. Dark: navy-850, one step lighter than the card, because on a dark ground height reads as light; the accent keeps 4.64:1 on it. Light: white. Player: navy-900.

tokens.name: surface-edge
tokens.usage: The hairline round a card on the page (Panel, Table, LegalTextViewer), `hairline` wide on every theme. Dark: navy-800, because navy-900 on navy-950 (1.20:1) is too close to hold a card alone. Transparent on the light theme and the Player, so the edge is there and shows nothing: the theme lives in this colour, never in the width, and a card is the same size on every theme. Never a divider inside a card: that is `border`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: A grouped row inside a card (FieldRow), a sunken panel inside a card, a disabled field. Dark: navy-950, the page colour again, used only inside cards. Light: navy-50. Player: navy-900.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a modal Dialog or a SidePanel. Dark: navy-950 at 72 %. Light: Midnight Navy at 35 %. Player: navy-975 at 60 %. Never a surface or a text colour.

tokens.name: material-bar
tokens.usage: Glass for a bar that content scrolls under: the top bar of the three shells and the phone bottom bar of PortalShell. Always paired with `backdrop-material`. Dark: Midnight Navy at 82 % (72 % let Digital Teal fall to 4.17:1 over a white sheet); light: white at 86 %. Worst case over a white or a black block after the backdrop filter: dark on-surface 11.42:1, on-surface-secondary 7.70:1, on-surface-muted 5.86:1, accent 4.57:1; light on-surface 13.08:1, accent 4.79:1. Muted text is not set on light glass. Solid `surface` when the browser has no backdrop filter or the reader asks for less transparency or more contrast.

tokens.name: material-float
tokens.usage: Glass for a layer that opens over the page: Menu, Combobox list, Toggletip, Toast, the DateField calendar, the PortalShell phone sheet. Never a card, a panel, a table row or a dialog. Dark: navy-850 at 80 %, so it stays lighter than the card it opens over; light: white at 86 %. Worst case after the backdrop filter: dark on-surface 10.01:1, on-surface-muted 5.14:1, danger-text 5.83:1. Digital Teal falls to 4.01:1 there, so inside these layers the accent steps up to accent-strong (teal-300, 5.57:1; bundle.css, Materials). Solid `surface-raised` under the same fallbacks as `material-bar`.

tokens.name: material-highlight
tokens.usage: A one-pixel light edge along the top inside a glass layer (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0), the way light catches the rim of a sheet of glass. Decoration only, never a boundary.

tokens.name: player-glass
tokens.usage: Glass on the Player while a track plays: the rail, the rail's sync button on the tablet and the staff screen, and on the guest display the cover and code column and the scan strip (`r1-glass`). A white veil over the out-of-focus cover (PlayerAmbient); the ambient is blurred once, so this is a plain see-through fill with no backdrop filter. Measured on the real ground at all five frame sizes, both tones and a near-white catalogue image: text on it holds 7.48:1 or more on the device and 7.9:1 on the guest display.

tokens.name: player-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass for a control on the playing Player: the round Previous and Next buttons, the rail's sync button, the volume track. One step brighter than `player-glass`, so a control reads as a raised piece of glass.

tokens.name: player-glass-hover
tokens.usage: A glass control under the pointer on the playing Player.

tokens.name: player-glass-edge
tokens.usage: The hairline round a piece of Player glass and the dividers that cross it, in place of the tone's 800 step, so a line shows on any part of the ambient.

tokens.name: player-glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The one-pixel light along the top of a glass control on the Player, the way light catches the rim of glass. Decoration only.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Body and heading text. Dark: navy-50 (#F0F4F8), a step below white so long text does not glare: 13.25:1 on the card, 15.93:1 on the page, 11.59:1 on a raised layer. Light: Midnight Navy (navy-900), the colour of the logo's wordmark: 14.64:1 on white, 13.25:1 on the page. Player: white.

tokens.name: on-surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text. Dark: navy-200: 8.93:1 on the card, 7.82:1 on a raised layer. Light: navy-600: 6.08:1 on white, 5.50:1 on the page. Player: navy-100, 11.34:1 on its lightest ground.

tokens.name: on-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, timestamps. Dark: navy-300: 6.80:1 on the card, 8.18:1 on the page, 5.95:1 on a raised layer, so muted text may sit on every dark ground. Light: navy-500: 4.79:1 on white and 4.34:1 on the page. Player: navy-200, 8.93:1 on its lightest ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between sections, rows and bars. Decorative: never the only edge of a control. Dark: white at 10 %, so a divider sits one quiet step above any ground it crosses. Light: navy-100, the light grey of the logo's palette strip (#DDE3EB). Player: navy-800.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox boundary, held to the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11. Dark: navy-400: 5.02:1 on the card, 6.04:1 on the page, 4.40:1 on a raised layer. Light: navy-500: 4.79:1 on white, 4.34:1 on the page. Player: navy-400.

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Edge of a disabled button on its own fill, weaker than border-control so the shape still shows; disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 1.4.11 and the reason line carries the meaning. Dark: navy-700. Light: navy-200. Player: navy-700.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Words and icons of a disabled control (exempt; the reason line carries the meaning). Dark: navy-500, 3.06:1 on the card. Light: navy-500, 4.79:1 on white. Player: navy-400.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Link, primary action, current item: the logo's Digital Teal. Dark: teal-500, exactly #00A8D9: 5.30:1 on the card, 6.37:1 on the page, 4.64:1 on a raised layer and on a hovered row; small marks drawn in the accent (a ticked box, the chosen day, the current step) carry navy-950 on it (6.37:1), as the logo's app icon sets teal on navy. A filled button takes the deeper `button-primary` instead. Light (paper): teal-700, the same hue dark enough for text, 5.36:1 on white and 4.85:1 on the page. Player: teal-300, 9.70:1 on the page.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover on an accent mark (a ticked box), a quiet button's words under the pointer, accent text that must read on a hovered layer or on opened glass, the current navigation entry. Dark: teal-300, 5.46:1 over the hover layer on a card. Light: teal-800. Player: teal-200.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: An accent mark while it is pressed (filled buttons use `button-primary-pressed`). Dark: teal-200, navy-950 on it 11.30:1. Light: teal-900, white on it 11.18:1. Player: teal-100.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Selected row, active navigation. Dark: teal-950 (on it the accent keeps 5.32:1, on-surface 13.29:1). Light: teal-50. Player: teal-950.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: A mark or label on an accent fill: the tick in a box, the chosen day, the current step. Dark: navy-950 on Digital Teal, 6.37:1. Light: white on teal-700, 5.36:1. Player: navy-950 on teal-300, 8.86:1. Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (outline-2 outline-offset-2). Dark: Digital Teal, 5.30:1 on the card and 4.64:1 on a raised layer. Light: teal-600, 3.67:1 on white. Player: teal-300.

tokens.name: positive-fill
tokens.usage: Positive family fill: meters, step marks. Dark: green-400 (8.40:1 on the card). Light: green-600, 3.30:1 on white as a non-text mark.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Positive badge and banner background. Dark: green-400 at 12 %, a quiet tint on a navy ground where a 950 step reads as a heavy block. Light: green-50. Player: green-950.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Positive text and badge icon. Dark: green-400, 6.45:1 on its tint over a card. Light: green-700, 4.79:1 on green-50.

tokens.name: attention-fill
tokens.usage: Attention family fill. Never text or an icon on a light tint (1.67:1 on white). Dark: amber-400.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Attention badge and banner background. Dark: amber-400 at 12 %. Light: amber-50. Player: amber-950.

tokens.name: attention-text
tokens.usage: Attention text and badge icon. Dark: amber-300, 7.98:1 on its tint over a card. Light: amber-700, 4.84:1 on amber-50.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Words and icons on `attention-fill`, where the fill itself is the ground: the console's notice strip. Dark: navy-950 on amber-400, 10.55:1. Light: Midnight Navy on it, 8.77:1.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger family fill: an error border, a meter over its limit, the danger notice strip (a destructive button takes `button-danger`). Dark: red-400, navy-950 on it 6.36:1. Light: red-600, white on it 4.83:1.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger badge and banner background. Dark: red-400 at 12 %. Light: red-50. Player: red-950.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger text and badge icon. Dark: red-300, 6.60:1 on its tint over a card. Light: red-700, 5.91:1 on red-50.

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Kept for compatibility: a destructive button now takes `button-danger-pressed`. Dark: red-300, navy-950 on it 9.28:1. Light: red-800, white on it 8.31:1.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Words on a danger fill: the danger notice strip. Dark and Player: navy-950. Light: white.

tokens.name: neutral-fill
tokens.usage: Neutral family fill: draft, closed, historical, superseded. Dark: navy-400. Light: navy-500.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: The neutral badge ground. Dark and Player: navy-700, so a neutral badge shows on a sunken band; neutral-text on it 5.27:1. Light: navy-100.

tokens.name: neutral-text
tokens.usage: Neutral text and badge icon. Dark: navy-200. Light: navy-600, 4.71:1 on navy-100.

tokens.name: info-fill
tokens.usage: The info shape and meter fill: offline but still playing, queued, syncing, in progress. The logo's blue, a hue of its own beside the teal accent, so information never reads as a link or the current item; it is also lighter than the accent on the dark theme and the Player, so the two differ in lightness as well as hue. Dark: blue-300. Light: blue-600 (#027EC3). Player: blue-400.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: The info badge and banner ground. Dark: blue-300 at 12 %. Light: blue-50. Player: blue-950.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info words and icons. Dark: blue-200, 6.96:1 on its tint over a card. Light: blue-800 (#044E88, from the logo), 7.64:1 on blue-50 and 7.75:1 on the page. Player: blue-100 on blue-950, 11.43:1.

tokens.name: code-paper
tokens.usage: Background of a QR code. Always white: a QR code and a printed record stay dark on white on every theme.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Modules of a QR code and printed text. Dark: navy-950 on white, 17.61:1. Light: Midnight Navy on white, 14.64:1.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the logo's teal. Dark: teal-500, 5.30:1 on the card. Light: teal-600, 3.67:1 on white. Player: teal-300.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, the logo's blue, set lighter than series 1 on the dark theme and darker on the light theme and the Player, so the two saturated series differ in lightness as well as hue. No series uses green, amber or red: a series is not a state. Dark: blue-200 (8.67:1 on the card). Light: blue-800 (8.57:1 on white). Player: blue-400 (4.51:1 on its lightest ground).

tokens.name: chart-3

backdrop.note: Backdrop filters for glass. Only two layers carry them: the bars that content scrolls under and the layers that open over the page.

tokens.name: backdrop-material
tokens.usage: Paired with `material-bar` and `material-float`: the glass of the dark theme and the Player. The blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and the saturation give the glass: colour passing under shows as a soft glow. The brightness keeps text legible whatever passes under it: the backdrop is darkened to 40 % before the tint. Tailwind: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-[1.8] backdrop-brightness-[.4]. A value per theme is not something this file can hold outside colours and shadows, so the light theme's glass is its own token, `backdrop-material-light`, and `bundle.css` points `backdrop-material` at it inside `data-theme="light"`.

tokens.name: backdrop-material-light
tokens.usage: The glass of the light theme, which `data-theme="light"` puts in place of `backdrop-material`: the backdrop's contrast is cut to 25 % and it is lifted before the white tint, so text keeps 4.5:1 over a black cover. Tailwind: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-[1.8] backdrop-contrast-25 backdrop-brightness-[1.7]. Light is the theme of paper; no product screen shows light glass today.

tokens.name: backdrop-scrim
tokens.usage: Paired with `scrim` behind a modal Dialog: the page under it softens as well as dims, so the dialog is the only sharp thing on screen. backdrop-blur-sm.

tokens.name: player-ambient
tokens.usage: The filter on the Player's ambient cover (PlayerAmbient): the cover, drawn at 140 % of the frame's width, goes fully out of focus and is darkened a quarter, so no groove or edge of the image can be read under text. Applied once to a still layer, never as a backdrop filter.
